retention_tricks: Rapid Cuts: Quick, dynamic edits every 1-3 seconds to maintain visual interest.
Text Overlays: On-screen text highlighting key points or adding context.
Sound Design: Engaging sound effects, background music, or unexpected audio cues.
Pattern Interrupts: Sudden changes in music, visuals, or speech patterns.
Story Arc (Mini): Introduce a problem, offer a solution, show the result.
Intrigue/Question Loop: Pose a question early, promise the answer, deliver it near the end.
